Airbus UK Broughton Football Club is a semi-professional football club based in Broughton, Flintshire, Wales. They had their origins as the works team of the Airbus UK factory in Broughton where the wings of Airbus aircraft are produced, and are consequently nicknamed The Wingmakers or The Planemakers. They play in the Cymru Premier.
